title: No More Meshes
description: Getting bored crafting sieve meshes? This mod might be a solution.
body:
This mod is an addon to [Ex Deorum](https://modrinth.com/mod/ex-deorum)

Getting bored crafting sieve meshes? This mod brings sieves with meshes back from the classic mod: [Ex Nihilo](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ex-nihilo) for Minecraft v1.7.10.

If you applied this mod, you can craft sieves with meshes with legacy recipes for it.

Such as:
![Legacy Sieve Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/296fb0954209109f4d39ab2cc363f99e7966deda.png)
![Legacy Compressed Sieve Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7161aa452e9b9ae791345b4ff78dae8428c7617b.png)

These sieves can use directly without complex meshes used.

All the meshes are able for these recipes, but don't worry, when you're using these sieves, all the recipes are accepted no matter which mesh it required.
